mission: Implement the Planner orchestration layer with reinforcement learning

key_features: Reinforcement scoring system with configurable points
AI-driven lineup selection based on personality
planner_personalities: growth_maximizer - Aggressive, takes chances on new agents
diversifier - Spreads risk across many agents
core_functions_implemented: getPlanner() - Get specific planner by ID
updatePlannerScore() - Apply reinforcement learning score changes
performMitosis() - Split high-scoring planner into two children
spawnNewPlanner() - Create new planner when population is low
recordScoreEvent() - Log and apply score changes

absorbed_traits_structure.pattern_preferences: Track which patterns lead to success
absorbed_traits_structure.personality_biases: Track which agent personalities perform well

lineup_selection_process: 1. Retrieve planner personality and absorbed traits
2. Get all active agents with performance metrics
4. Query AI model (Llama 3.1 8B) for agent selection
5. Parse AI response to extract agent IDs
6. Fallback to fitness-based selection if parsing fails
mitosis_process: 2. Create two children with score = parent.score / 2
4. Inherit absorbed traits with deep copy

score_weighted_consensus.description: Multiple planners vote on decisions with weights based on their scores
score_weighted_consensus.use_case: Committee-based trading decisions with experienced planner bias

next_steps: Add planner orchestration to scheduled cycles
Implement committee voting in trade decision flow
Tune scoring parameters based on performance

typescript_features: Full TypeScript interfaces for type safety
JSON serialization for complex fields (lineup_ids, absorbed_traits)
database_operations: UPDATE for score changes, lineup updates, status changes
SELECT for querying active planners, leaderboards
JSON functions for storing/retrieving complex objects
ai_integration: Cloudflare AI binding for model inference
Fallback logic for AI parsing failures
Structured output format (JSON) for agent selection

testing_recommendations: E2E tests for lineup selection with mock AI
Load tests for multiple concurrent planners
Simulation tests for score evolution over time
